info.description:
A spatial API for finding nearby geographic features using K-nearest-neighbour
and polygon-within queries backed by an in-memory spatial index.
info.title: Freegle Spatial (KNN) API

get.description: Returns {"status":"ok"} when the service is up. Used by Docker healthchecks.

parameters.description: Dataset name (e.g. locations, messages, userapproxlocs, jobs, groups, postcodes, newsfeed)
parameters.name: dataset

parameters.description: Number of results to return (1–1000, default 1)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Optional feature-type filter (dataset-specific, e.g. "Postcode" for locations)
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: WKT polygon to restrict results to (optional; use POST /within_coords for large polygons)
parameters.name: polygon

post.description:
Triggers an asynchronous full rebuild of the named dataset from MySQL.
The rebuild runs in a background goroutine; the endpoint returns immediately.
Response on 200: {"status":"rebuilding","dataset":"\u003cname\u003e"}

IMPORTANT: this route is served on SPATIAL_ADMIN_PORT (default 8195), not the
public SPATIAL_PORT (default 8194). It must not be exposed to the public network.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: JSON object with an "ids" array of int64 IDs to remove

post.description:
Inserts or replaces specific items in the spatial index by WKT geometry.
Intended for integration tests: seeds a known geometry into the live index
(decoupled from the nightly MySQL rebuild) and removes it afterwards.
Request body: {"items": [{"id": int64, "wkt": "WKT string", "extra": {...}}]}
Response on 200: {"upserted": count}

IMPORTANT: this route is served on SPATIAL_ADMIN_PORT (default 8195), not the
public SPATIAL_PORT (default 8194). It must not be exposed to the public network.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: JSON object with an "items" array; each item has id (int64), wkt (WKT polygon or point string), and optional extra (arbitrary JSON object)

post.description:
Returns full item objects (including extra fields such as coordinates) for all
records whose geometry falls inside the given WKT polygon.
Use this POST form for large isochrone polygons that exceed safe URL length limits.
Response: {"results": [{"extra": {...}}]}

Accepts Content-Type: text/plain (raw WKT body) or
application/x-www-form-urlencoded with field polygon=\u003cWKT\u003e.

Binds to SPATIAL_PORT (default 8194).
post.summary: Within polygon — return items with coordinates (POST)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: WKT polygon as raw text body (Content-Type text/plain) or polygon=<WKT> form field

errorResponse.description: errorResponse is a JSON error response containing a single "error" string field: {"error": "message"}

genericResponse.description: genericResponse is a generic JSON response; actual fields depend on the endpoint (see each route description)
